title: Theatre Reviews Macbeth
venue: Hart House Theatre; Equity Showcase Theatre

THEATRE REVIEWS MACBETH

Tuesday, March 31, 1992

ROBERT CUSHMAN

Toronto ONT -- BY WILLIAM SHAKESPEARE Directed by Robert Lepage At Hart House Theatre MACBETH BY WILLIAM SHAKESPEARE Directed by Alex Fallis Starring David Schurmann and Kate Lynch At Equity Showcase Theatre Rating: The traditional amateur virtues - intelligence and vigour - are neutralized in a production of Macbeth by Robert Lepage Double, double, toil and trouble BY ROBERT CUSHMAN Special to The Globe and Mail Toronto ROBERT Lepage's production of Macbeth, recently performed by the Graduate Centre for the Study of Drama at the University of Toronto, begins tremendously with the three witches hanging upside-down; talk about the suspension of disbelief. Then Macbeth and Banquo appear, riding. They are not actually on horseback, but they are performing a detailed and energetic equestrian mime, which they accompany with much syncopated stomping of feet. They are joined by a couple of message-bearing thanes who are executing the same routine. In the received text this is the play's third scene; the first two have been cut.
